name: Fenwick Thatros
summary: In the Undercity, Mennet Carkad sends promising rogues to kill Fenwick Thatros on Lord Varimathras's orders. Thatros is suspected of gathering independent undead along Silverpine Forest's shores. His death proves an operative's mettle to the Deathstalkers and earns access to advanced trade training.

sections.title: A Command from the Dreadlord
sections.body: In the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, Mennet Carkad handles Deathstalker contracts and trains rogues. The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's secretive intelligence wing. Lord Varimathras has named Fenwick Thatros a priority target, a charge too serious for novice recruits. Thatros has established a foothold among rogue undead in Silverpine Forest. Left alone, their independent leaders could threaten Forsaken control across Lordaeron's old holdings.

sections.title: The Decrepit Dock on Lordamere
sections.body: Deathstalker scouts place Fenwick Thatros near a decrepit dock on Lake Lordamere in Silverpine Forest. To reach him, you must cross wilderness claimed by feral beasts, Rot Hide gnolls, and Scourge remnants. Varimathras demands proof of the kill: Thatros's severed head. Bring it back, and you may earn entry into deeper covert operations.

faq.answer: Fenwick Thatros leads undead near Lake Lordamere in Silverpine Forest. He commands pockets of undead unaligned with or hostile to the Undercity, unlike Forsaken who serve Lady Sylvanas. Lord Varimathras has marked him for execution.

faq.q: Why does Varimathras want Fenwick Thatros dead?
faq.answer: Varimathras wants Fenwick Thatros dead because he could rally stray undead in Silverpine against the Forsaken. Rival leaders who threaten Sylvanas's control over the region must be eliminated to secure the Undercity's borders.

The Deathstalkers are the Forsaken's agency for espionage, assassination, and reconnaissance. Based in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter, they work across Lordaeron to remove internal threats, spy on rival factions, and secure territory for the Dark Lady.
Deathstalker reports place Fenwick Thatros near a ruined dock on Lake Lordamere's shore in northeastern Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What does completing this mission earn with the Deathstalkers?
faq.answer: Killing Fenwick Thatros proves your ability and loyalty to Mennet Carkad and the Deathstalkers. Once you have shown you can be trusted, Carkad offers specialized training in the shadow arts.
Mennet Carkad trains rogues and handles Deathstalker affairs in the Undercity's Rogues' Quarter. He oversees field agents and assigns work tied to the Forsaken realm's security.

angles.text: As a rogue, you prove your stealth and lethality through this contract. Then the Deathstalkers may trust you with deeper tools of their trade.
As one of the Forsaken, you know rival undead factions cannot claim sovereignty so close to the Capital City. Fenwick Thatros's head is a political necessity.
